name: Marble Chain
author: Cyberdelia
help: A chain of balls rolls toward the hole. Shoot balls into it: three or more of one colour together pop. Where a gap's two sides match, the chain rolls back to close it, and that can pop again for a bigger score. Rest your thumb on the wheel to aim, tap Select to shoot, hold Select (or press Play) to swap your two balls. Balls with a mark carry a power-up: slow, back or bomb. Clear all six levels before the chain reaches the hole.

options.name: steering
options.title: Aiming
options.help: Thumb: the gun points where your thumb rests on the wheel. Spin: turning the wheel turns the gun, finer, and Prev and Next turn it too.
